title: My mall is falling apart
content: I had the dream on Xmas eve and I was walking through the upstairs and all of the usual stores were gone and replaced with ridiculously fancy stores selling huge pieces of art and jewelry. There was a sales guy outside of the art store who was kind of making fun of me so I didn't go in. At some point I realized I was having the dream and I ran out to get my son and show him the mall cuz he has asked me a million questions about it. Anyway when I came back with him, all of the stores were closed and boarded up. The second floor was crumbling and there were sections of the walkway that had fallen down and were replaced with boards. We were scared walking over them and I told him I was sorry, it is usually better than this. We actually managed to leave the mall, but the whole neighborhood outside the mall was abandoned and run down too. There were the usual zombies milling around outside but they were angry and agitated. Anyone else have problems with leaving the mall and coming back? Is it ruined forever because I brought someone back with me?
